launch.observed: Academy surface launches with three built-in public courses and generic runtime navigation.

installed_public_courses.observed: CompTIA A+, Network+, and Security+ are visible in the installed-course registry.

generic_classroom.observed: A+ lesson completion changes the namespaced progress badge from 0/68 to 1/68 and reports saved completion.

lecture_and_fallback.observed: Authored lecture segment renders and deterministic instructor fallback is bounded to CompTIA A+ with no progress authority.

assignments_and_assessments.observed: Generic assignments render and a practice attempt is recorded in the course namespace.

deterministic_labs.observed: A bounded local Lab starts with authored state and explicitly reports no shell, process, filesystem, network, or provider authority.

valid_package_import.observed: The valid public-safe fixture installs as Example Public Course and becomes the selected course.

invalid_package_rejection.observed: The executable fixture is rejected with package.command is not allowed in a declarative package.

multi_course_isolation.observed: A+ remains at 1/68 while Network+ independently reports 1/41 after separate lesson completion.

legacy_workspace_handoff.observed: The explicit compatibility action renders the existing certification workspace.
